## Typst-native fonts, WebP display sheets, click-to-copy workspace path

Builds on **0.1.28**.

### Typst fonts
- **`DOCUMENT_FONTS` uses real Typst `FontInfo`** for every system face (family trim, flags, axes, cmap coverage) via fontdb memmap — same model as `typst` / LaTeX-like selection.
- Removes the fabricated Latin-ish coverage stubs that made arbitrary `#set text(font: …)` faces look wrong.
- Heap still holds only metadata + path slots until Typst selects a face; CJK coverage remains accurate.

### Display-side memory
- Preview / live Typst sheets and Mermaid sharp views cache as **lossless WebP** (GPUI `ImageFormat::Webp`). Measured far smaller and faster than JPEG q82 for page-like rasters; JPEG/PNG remain encode fallbacks.
- AVIF / JPEG XL are not GPUI formats, so they were not chosen.

### Explorer
- **Click the workspace folder name** in the Explorer header to copy the absolute workspace path (tooltip: full path — click to copy).

### Verify
- Unit tests: real FontInfo flags, arbitrary system font shaping + WebP sheets, CJK coverage, WebP size wins.
- Xvfb: Passion One Typst preview paints; Explorer header click copies workspace absolute path; `document_fonts` memmap index.
